newsitem.title: INDIA: India Hind Motors up eight pct at BSE.
newsitem.headline: India Hind Motors up eight pct at BSE.

text.p: Shares of India's Hindustan Motors advanced 1.50 rupees, or 7.69 percent, to 21.0 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Monday, dealers said.
Newspapers on Monday reported that Mitsubishi Motors will acquire a 10 percent stake in the company.
The Asian Age newspaper quoted A. Sankara Narayanan, executive director of Hindustan Motors as saying Mitsubishi was awaiting clearance from the Foreign Investment Promotion Board.
Hindustan Motors was up 1.10 rupees to 21.0 at the National Stock Exchange with 212,500 shares traded.
